Script tags nested inside SVG are stripped

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<p>Before SVG.</p><svg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\"><script>alert('svg-xss')</script><text>SVG text</text></svg><p>After SVG.</p>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content())
```
